questions.prompt: What does the business sell, in one sentence?
What proof do you have that you got results for people like them? Name the strongest one.
What is your contribution margin as a percent? Give your best honest number.
How many recovery reviews can you actually handle per week?
Where do you want people to end up: a booking page, a billing portal, a reorder page, or something else?
What kind of business is this: recurring (saas or membership), one-time product (ecommerce), or booked service?
For customers who left, how many months did a typical customer stay? This is the tenure multiple used to size what each lost customer is worth.
Optional: hard-set a lifetime value per customer in dollars. Leave blank to let the tenure multiple do the work.

boundary_confirmations.prompt: Confirm inputs stay read-only: no sending, no scheduling, no CRM or payment writes, no audience creation.
Confirm nothing in this run sends anything. You hit send yourself, from your own tools.
Confirm a live HubSpot or Stripe read happens only if you explicitly authorize it and supply credentials in the environment.
